hypothesisMarkdown:
## One-path clips transformed into place Hypothesis

A clip drawn as one path (all its outlines in the frame's space) made a transformed copy of each outline and appended it; it was to append the transformed points directly.\n\n**Tested mechanism:** in-place transform of one-path clips. **Allowed:** core `frame.rs`, `geom.rs`. **Forbidden:** other paths.
